from fixtures import load_fixtures, ROWS
from unique import new_clubs

EXPECTED = list(dict.fromkeys(k for k, _ in ROWS))


def test_called_twice():
    data = list(load_fixtures())
    new_clubs(data)
    assert new_clubs(data) == EXPECTED


def test_known_values_left_out():
    data = list(load_fixtures())
    assert new_clubs(data, {EXPECTED[0]}) == EXPECTED[1:]
